action: A cat looking up at three-quarter view turns its head toward the right until it is nearly in profile.
identity_gap: The cartoon cat is built like a traced photo: a rounded tilted head in three-quarter view with nose, mouth, neck/shoulder lines and grey secondary strokes. The doodle is a flat, frontal, head-only polygon with a straight top edge, tall ears on that edge, large open eyes, no nose or mouth, and whiskers that cut straight across the face outline.
notes: The strokes are similar (angular polylines, open oval eyes), but frames 2 to 3 pop the left ear from a stick into a triangle, and frames 6 to 7 jump to a profile pose with the head shifted, a slit eye and whiskers moved, with no in-between. The stray grey ghost lines around the head edge make both the motion and the identity harder to read.
